title: Edit goals right in Goal buckets
subtitle: Simple > Priorities > Goal buckets: add, edit and archive goals, and move features between them. Invented company: an e-bike subscription service.

decisions.name: Add and edit a goal
decisions.question: How is a goal added and edited from the buckets, and what must it have?
decisions.common: Owners and approvers see the controls; viewers and commenters see none (checked through can(), never by role name). A goal has a name, a measure, a target and a date; its small order number is the owner's and is set in Baseline. Saving updates the same goal Baseline shows, with Undo.

proposals.name: Pencil, form in place
proposals.what: Each bucket header gets a pencil. It turns that header into a small form right where it sits: the goal, its measure, its target and its date, with its order number shown but set in Baseline. A dashed "+ Add goal" bucket at the end opens the same form as goal 6. Save stays off until the measure, the target and the date are all there.
proposals.why: The change happens where the person is looking, one goal at a time, and works the same on a phone. It is the smallest step from today's buckets and needs no new screen.
proposals.plus: One click to edit; nothing covers the features; the add bucket shows where a new goal will land in the order.
proposals.cost: The bucket grows while the form is open, so cards beside it shift down; one goal at a time.

proposals.name: Menu and side panel
proposals.what: Each bucket header gets a "⋯" menu with Edit goal and Archive goal; "+ Add goal" sits above the buckets. Edit and Add open a panel at the right with the goal, measure, target, date, its place in the order and the features under it. On a phone the panel fills the screen.
proposals.plus: Room for the fields and for what the goal holds; the buckets do not move; one menu also carries Archive.
proposals.cost: Two clicks to start an edit, and the panel hides half the buckets while it is open.

proposals.name: Edit goals mode
proposals.what: One "Edit goals" button above the buckets turns every header into fields at once and folds the feature lists away. People change several goals, then Save all or Discard. Each goal also gets an Archive link while in this mode.
proposals.plus: Best for a goal review where several goals change together; one save, one undo.
proposals.cost: Features are hidden while editing, so you edit without seeing the work; with eight goals it is a long form.

proposals.name: Name now, fill later
proposals.what: An always-there "Add a goal" line at the end takes just a name and Enter. The new bucket shows at once, flagged "Needs a measure, a target and a date", and its pencil opens the same small form to finish it. A goal is valid with a name; the flag stays until it has all three.
proposals.plus: Fastest way to get a goal down in a meeting; features can be moved under it straight away.
proposals.cost: Goals with no measure exist and can sit unfinished; the flag has to be cleared later.

decisions.name: Archive a goal
decisions.question: How is a goal archived, and what happens to its features and milestones?
decisions.common: Only owners and approvers can archive. Milestones are never changed: the work in them moves with its features. Each feature keeps the other goals it serves. Every archive has Undo.

proposals.name: Pick where they go
proposals.what: Archive goal asks first. It says what the goal holds (its features and the milestones their work is in). Features that serve another goal too go to that goal; for the rest, pick a goal, or leave them with no goal. Archive saves it all in one step, and Undo puts every link back.
proposals.why: Nothing is lost or left hidden, the common case is one choice, and features that already serve another goal land in the right place on their own.
proposals.plus: One dialog, one choice; milestones are untouched; a clear Undo.
proposals.cost: A bulk move can put features under a goal they fit badly; that needs a second look afterwards.

proposals.name: Empty it first
proposals.what: A goal can only be archived once nothing sits under it. Archive goal on a goal with features says so, lists them, and offers to move them all to one goal right there; once empty, Archive goal works and needs no choice.
proposals.plus: Archiving is never a surprise; every feature is moved on purpose.
proposals.cost: Two steps every time; with 15 features the person has to place them before the goal can go.

proposals.name: Archive, sort later
proposals.what: Archive goal acts at once, with Undo. Features that serve another goal move there; the rest drop to the No goal bucket, marked as coming from the archived goal. The goal itself goes to an "Archived goals" shelf at the end, where it can be brought back.
proposals.plus: One click; no dialog; an archived goal can come back later.
proposals.cost: Work quietly piles up under No goal, which then needs sorting by hand.

proposals.name: Place each feature
proposals.what: Archive goal opens a list of the goal's features, each with its own goal picker, set to another goal it serves when it has one and to No goal otherwise. The person sets each, then archives.
proposals.plus: Each feature lands exactly where it belongs.
proposals.cost: A long list for a big goal: 15 pickers to set before archiving.

decisions.name: Move a feature
decisions.question: How does a feature move to another goal, and how does one that serves several goals show?
decisions.common: A feature sits once, under the goal it moves most (its first goal link). One that serves other goals too shows "+1 goal" beside its name, naming them on hover. A move saves the feature's "Goals it serves" links, the same ones Baseline edits, with Undo. Only owners and approvers can move.

proposals.name: Drag to a goal
proposals.what: Each feature row gets a grip. Drag it onto another bucket: that bucket lights up and says it becomes the goal the feature moves most. Dropping saves it as the feature's first goal link and drops the old one, with Undo.
proposals.plus: Direct and quick on a big screen when both buckets are in view.
proposals.cost: Hard when the target bucket is far down the page (eight goals) and on a phone; needs a keyboard fallback.

proposals.name: Move to goal menu
proposals.what: Each feature row gets a "⋯". It lists the goals in the owner's order with their numbers: "here now" on the current one and "also serves" on the others it serves. Picking one makes it the feature's only goal link, so the feature moves there; Undo puts the old links back. A feature that serves several goals shows "+1 goal" beside its name.
proposals.why: It works the same with a mouse, a keyboard and a thumb, shows every goal at once even with eight, and says plainly what the links become.
proposals.plus: Works on a phone and by keyboard; the goals' numbers match the owner's order.
proposals.cost: One feature at a time, and two clicks for each move.

proposals.name: Tick and move
proposals.what: "Pick features to move" puts a box on every feature row. Tick any number across buckets; a bar at the bottom says how many and moves them all to one goal.
proposals.plus: Best for big clean-ups, such as emptying a goal before archiving it.
proposals.cost: A mode to enter and leave; overkill for moving one feature.

proposals.name: Edit its goal links
proposals.what: Each feature row gets a target button that opens its "Goals it serves" links, as Baseline holds them: a tick for each goal it serves and a choice of the one it moves most. The feature sits in that bucket; the other goals it serves list it as "Also served here".
proposals.plus: Shows and edits the links fully; nothing about several goals is hidden.
proposals.cost: The most to read and set; a large box for a quick move.
